_instructions: Copy this file to a real name (e.g. au-banks.json) and delete this key.
Files starting with _ are ignored by the build.
One entry per company per reporting period. Every field below is required
unless marked optional. source.page is mandatory on purpose: a figure whose
page cannot be cited was not properly read, and the register's lesson is that
an unciteable number should be visible as such rather than smoothed over.
Do not add an entry you have not read in the original document.
entity: Exact legal name as printed in the report

assurance.provider: Name of the assurance firm, or null

source.publisher: Who published it — usually the company

note: Optional. Anything a reader needs in order not to misuse the figure — restatements, boundary changes, a category reported on a different basis.
